findings.claim: With four cards on the 844×390 phone, the track names no longer fit on one line. Two-word names break mid-name ('DUST / BOWL', 'BRAMBLE / BENDS'), while 'PINE RIDGE' and 'HAY LOOP' stay on one line. So the plates in the row have uneven name blocks, unlike S6, where every name is one line above its BEST line.
findings.evidence: Screenshot /inputs/screenshots/844x390/stage/start--menu.png next to guardrails/design/mockups/S6-title-track-select.png. In the mockup, DUST BOWL, HAY LOOP and PINE RIDGE are each one line. In the screenshot, the second card reads 'DUST' / 'BOWL' on two lines and the first reads 'BRAMBLE' / 'BENDS'. Cards 3 and 4 are one line. The same holds in start--menu-unlocked.png. The arithmetic for 844 wide: .ui-start__select is about 844 − 281 (brand, 1/3) − 24 (s5 left padding) − 48 (safe-right) ≈ 491px. Four cards and three s2 gaps leave each card about 117px (the screenshot measures about 114px: 316→430). The plate's content box is about 117 − 8 (4px borders) − 16 (s2 padding) ≈ 93px, too narrow for 'DUST BOWL' at --type-button-size 22px italic 900. .ui-track-card__name has no nowrap, so the name wraps. AC10 checks only scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth, so the wrap passes the test but differs from the mockup.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep each name on one line as in S6: give the phone `.ui-track-card__name` `white-space: nowrap`, as `.ui-track-card__best` already has. Then free the width so the AC10 clip test still passes, for example by narrowing `.ui-start__select`'s left padding from var(--space-s5) to var(--space-s4) or letting the brand panel shrink. If the row can't fit one-line names at 844, write a design request instead of shipping wrapped names.

checked.target: Locked card vs S6 mockup (844×390 start--menu.png)
checked.how: Compared it with S6-title-track-select.png. The card and plate are dark dirt, the road is an ink outline, the cream padlock roundel sits centred on the outline, the name is cream, and the best reads 'BEST -:--.--'. They match.
Pine Ridge looks like the other cards: cream plate, cream road on an ink edge, no padlock. That matches AC10.
The desktop lock roundel has a 4px outline (desktop-outline) and scales with desktop-scale. All four cards are in one row with RACE bottom right. Nothing clips.

Every colour, size and radius comes from var(--…) tokens: dark-dirt, ink, cream, radius-round, outline-default, space-s*. No hex or px literals (the only 'px' Grep hit is a comment, as elsewhere in src/ui). There is no opacity, gradient, filter or blur.

checked.target: Locked card states vs UI_RULES §3/§7/§10 and plan audit
checked.how: [aria-disabled] hover, :active and :focus-visible set transform:none and the 4px button shadow. Its specificity (0,3,0) is equal to or higher than the lift and sink rules, and it comes later in the file, so it wins. The focus outline is kept. No shake animation was invented. The spec keeps the ink shadow ('not generic disabled').

The name and BEST label on the locked plate are cream on dark-dirt, which §2 allows at any size. The padlock is ink on cream with a 3px ink outline on a 40px roundel (over 32px, so the default outline is right).
It is two solid polygons on the 24 grid, filled with currentColor, not a thin-line icon (§11). It renders through the existing icon() helper.

track-card.ts: role=img with aria-label 'Locked'. The best is 'BEST ' plus formatOptionalTime(null) for locked cards. The name 'Pine Ridge' comes from the JSON and is uppercased by CSS, as on the other cards.
The cone trees are grass and deep-green with ink blob shadows, the road is dirt, and the HUD sits in its corner stacks. No off-palette colours seen.
